data.long_meaning: Mirshaq is a name derived from the Arabic word 'mirsah' which means 'light' or 'guidance'. The 'qa' suffix adds the meaning of 'giver'. So, Mirshaq means 'The light-giver' or 'The giver of guidance'. The name Mirshaq carries the meaning “The light-giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mirshaq usually hope their child will grow to embody the light-giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
